# Official Midnight Passport demo connector

Unmodified `packages/connect/src`, package manifest, compiler configuration,
README and Apache-2.0 licence from:

- Repository: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/passport-demo
- Commit: `d343acf6674b7258e04cad9eb5d64c054f0dfebd` (release v5.2)
- Source package: `@midnight-passport/connect` 0.1.1
- Imported: 9 November 2026

Vendored because publication of this small demo connector was not independently
confirmed. This is separate from the unreleased full Midnight Passport SDK.
Profile consent and redirect signatures do not establish account-contract control.
Changes to this directory must retain attribution and update this record.
